 Updated: 11:22 AM EST Nov 17, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Stephanie Moore Digital Content Manager BOILING SPRINGS, S.C. — A lottery player in South Carolina won $2 million with a scratch-off ticket, according to the South Carolina Education Lottery. 
 The winner, who does not want to be identified, bought the winning ticket at the KC Mart on Highway 9 in Boiling Springs. 
 Advertisement 400 new jobs coming to Cherokee County with new manufacturing facility planned “I still don’t really believe it,” the winner told South Carolina Education Lottery officials.

 For selling the claimed ticket, the KC Mart #8 in Boiling Springs received a commission of $20,000.
